practicalCriteria: Document control and scope are complete for a named site
Each register row names one hazard, is scored and banded correctly, and has ranked controls and a residual score
Each Medium or High row has an action or hold with an owner and due date
Briefing record and review fields are complete and contain only the briefed people and recorded triggers
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: site walk record used for the scope
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: The worksheet is issued with a High band row that has no hold
A briefing signature is entered for a person who was not briefed
